region: us-central1 (same as bucket, no cross-region egress)
config_source: official config/stargraph/5_5/{gpt,nextlat}_stargraph_5_5.yaml, overriding only step count, out_dir, compile, and corpus paths

projection.scope: 5 confirmatory seeds x {GPT, NextLat, BST} for Lure-Star; 5 x {GPT, NextLat} for HMM

known_measurement_gaps: BST has not been profiled at the 500-step paper-scale gate.
GPT and NextLat HMM have not been profiled for 300 steps, and the HMM 50-step trainer smoke is outstanding.
steady_seconds_per_step was parsed from the local log, not in-driver: the driver kept only a 60-line tail so its own estimate returned null (fixed in scripts/colab_profile.py for subsequent runs)

peak VRAM read torch.cuda stats in the driver process rather than the fabric child, so it reported 0.00 GB (fixed to poll nvidia-smi); peak VRAM is therefore NOT yet measured and must be captured during the profiling gate
